viewing_check: Armitage current bid $100, next bid $110, estimate 200-300. Now has real sold data: complete K970 saws sold A$234-912 on eBay AU in 2024-26 (7 sales), the lowest being an untested one at A$234.61 and a pre-owned K970 III at A$324.30; the typical working used price is about A$400-630. This saw is visibly worn and dirty and the K970 name suggests the older model, so expect the low end unless it runs. Check at viewing: pull the starter (compression), idle, throttle, clutch, cracked blade guard, and the decompression valve (older K970 had a button). Heavy (about 12 kg) and pickup or freight needed; the sale price is subject to running state, but even an untested saw sold A$234 so the downside is limited. One link (A$312.38, Aug 2025) could not be given with its item id because my read was cut off.
